note: Meet Jesus content. References only; the app shows the exact bundled text. Titles and notes were written for this app.
intro: Every answer in Bible Advisor leads here: to Jesus Christ, the Word who became flesh and lived among us (John 1:1, 14).

sections.title: Who He is
sections.summary: Jesus is the eternal Word, God the Son, who made all things and came to make peace with us.

items.title: The Word
items.note: Before the world began, Jesus already was. All things were made through Him.

items.title: The Word became flesh
items.note: God came close. Jesus lived a real human life, full of grace and truth.

items.title: The image of God
items.note: If you want to know what God is like, look at Jesus.

items.title: The peacemaker
items.note: Through the cross, Jesus makes peace between God and people.

items.title: Holding all things
items.note: Jesus shines with God's glory, holds the universe together, and cleansed our sins.

items.title: My Lord and my God
items.note: The doubter Thomas met the risen Jesus and worshipped Him.

sections.title: His “I am” sayings
sections.summary: In John's Gospel, Jesus describes Himself with seven pictures that show what He gives.

items.title: The bread of life
items.note: Jesus satisfies the deepest hunger of the soul.

items.title: The light of the world
items.note: Following Jesus means you do not walk in darkness.

items.title: The door
items.note: Jesus is the way in to safety and life with God.

items.title: The good shepherd
items.note: Jesus knows His sheep and gave His life for them.

items.title: The resurrection and the life
items.note: Death is not the end for those who believe in Him.

items.title: The way, the truth and the life
items.note: Jesus does not only point to God. He brings us to the Father.

items.title: The true vine
items.note: Stay connected to Jesus, and your life will bear fruit.

items.title: Before Abraham was, I am
items.note: Jesus used God's own name, "I am," for Himself.

sections.title: His parables
sections.summary: Jesus taught with stories from everyday life. Each one shows something about God's kingdom.

items.title: The lost sheep
items.note: The shepherd goes after the one that is lost, and heaven celebrates when it is found.

items.title: The lost son
items.note: The father runs to welcome his son home. This is the heart of God.

items.title: The good Samaritan
items.note: Loving your neighbor means stopping to help, whoever they are.

items.title: The sower
items.note: God's Word is like seed. The kind of heart that receives it matters.

items.title: The mustard seed
items.note: God's kingdom starts small and grows beyond imagining.

items.title: The hidden treasure and the pearl
items.note: Knowing Jesus is worth more than everything else.

items.title: The wise and foolish builders
items.note: Build your life on doing what Jesus says, and it will stand.

items.title: The Pharisee and the tax collector
items.note: God hears the humble prayer: "God be merciful to me a sinner."

sections.title: His miracles
sections.summary: Jesus' miracles show His power and His compassion. They are signs pointing to who He is.

items.title: Water into wine
items.note: Jesus' first sign, at a wedding, showed His glory.

items.title: Healing a leper
items.note: Jesus touched a man no one would touch, and made him clean.

items.title: Calming the storm
items.note: Even the wind and the sea obey Him.

items.title: Raising a little girl
items.note: Jesus took a girl by the hand and gave her life again.

items.title: Feeding five thousand
items.note: A boy's small lunch fed a crowd in Jesus' hands.

items.title: Walking on water
items.note: When Peter began to sink, Jesus caught him.

items.title: Healing blind Bartimaeus
items.note: Jesus asked, "What do you want me to do for you?"

items.title: Raising Lazarus
items.note: Jesus called a dead man out of the tomb.

sections.title: The Sermon on the Mount
sections.summary: Jesus' most famous teaching describes life in God's kingdom.

items.title: The Beatitudes
items.note: Jesus calls blessed the people the world overlooks.

items.title: Salt and light
items.note: Let your good works shine so people praise your Father.

items.title: Love your enemies
items.note: God's children love like their Father does.

items.title: The Lord's Prayer
items.note: Jesus teaches us how to pray.

items.title: Do not worry
items.note: Seek God's kingdom first and trust Him with tomorrow.

items.title: Ask, seek, knock
items.note: Your Father gives good gifts to those who ask Him.

items.title: The golden rule
items.note: Treat others the way you want to be treated.

items.title: Build on the rock
items.note: Hearing and doing Jesus' words gives a firm foundation.

sections.title: The cross
sections.summary: Jesus died for our sins, taking what we deserved so we could be forgiven.

items.title: Foretold
items.note: Hundreds of years earlier, Isaiah wrote of One who would be wounded for us.

items.title: "Father, forgive them"
items.note: Jesus prayed for the people crucifying Him.

items.title: The thief on the cross
items.note: A dying man asked Jesus to remember him, and was promised paradise.

items.title: "It is finished"
items.note: Jesus completed the work of saving us.

items.title: The veil torn
items.note: The way to God was opened, and a soldier saw that Jesus was the Son of God.

items.title: Love shown
items.note: Christ died for us while we were still sinners.

sections.title: The resurrection
sections.summary: On the third day Jesus rose from the dead. He is alive today.

items.title: He is risen
items.note: The tomb was empty, just as Jesus had said.

items.title: Touch me and see
items.note: The risen Jesus had a real body; He was not a ghost.

items.title: Peace be unto you
items.note: Jesus showed His wounds, and His friends were glad.

items.title: Thomas believes
items.note: Blessed are those who have not seen and yet believe.

items.title: Seen by many
items.note: The risen Jesus was seen by Peter, the twelve, and more than five hundred people.

items.title: He will come again
items.note: Jesus returned to heaven, and He will come back the same way.

know.title: How to know Jesus
know.intro: You do not need to clean up your life first. Jesus came for people who know they need Him.

steps.title: God loves you
steps.text: God made you and loves you more than you know. He wants you to know Him.

steps.title: Sin separates us from God
steps.text: All of us have done wrong. Our sin puts a wall between us and God, and we cannot remove it ourselves.

steps.title: Jesus came to save you
steps.text: Jesus, God the Son, died on the cross for your sins and rose again. He took the punishment we deserved.

steps.title: Salvation is a gift
steps.text: You cannot earn it. You receive it by trusting Jesus and turning to Him.

steps.title: Open the door
steps.text: Jesus is knocking. You can talk to Him right now, in your own words.

know.prayer: Lord Jesus, I know I have sinned and I need You. Thank You for dying on the cross for me and rising again. I believe You are the Son of God. Please forgive me and come into my life. I want to follow You as my Lord and Savior. Thank You for loving me. Amen.
know.next: If you prayed this, welcome to God's family! Tell a Christian you trust, find a church that teaches the Bible, and start reading the Gospel of John.
